text:
raj: CI on main is red across multiple builders, failing tests in tests/inference/kv_cache_test.py and tests/runtime/allocator_shard_test.py :sos:

alice: Ugh. Any recent merges that look suspicious? Last green reported by ci-dashboard is 1769499800. Can we bisect? :eyes:

kevin: I can start a bisect on a clean checkout. Quick question: do we want to use the flaky-guard branch run or straight git bisect between 1769499800..main?

maya: straight bisect is fine, but include the smoke test script to catch the failures quickly. Using `./dev/ci/run_smoke.sh` will reproduce the failing test locally.

kevin: starting `git bisect` now on my laptop. Will push results here.

kevin: ran `git bisect run ./dev/ci/run_smoke.sh` — first few candidates skipped due to env, then got a failing commit. Output snippet:
```
Bisecting: 12 revisions left to test after this (roughly)
# bad 1769504321 (HEAD)
# good 1769499800
XHR commit 5f2a1c7d added allocator shard mapping changes
... running ./dev/ci/run_smoke.sh
FAIL: tests/runtime/allocator_shard_test.py::test_shard_rebalance
```

maya: 5f2a1c7d is the change that touched allocator mapping + kv cache warmup. That looks very suspicious.

raj: who authored 5f2a1c7d? I think it was tom (tom-dev). Any quick revert plan?

alice: I can open a revert PR for 5f2a1c7d (safe revert) -> will target main and run full CI. Assigning to me. PR will be revert/allocator-shard-5f2a1c7d #4381.

kevin: pinging @tom for confirmation and for a follow-up fix. tom, can you look at the shard mapping change?

oncall: tagging incident process: if CI stays red for >30m we escalate. For now looks actionable.

ci-bot: Rebuild triggered: PR #4381 (revert 5f2a1c7d) — running on linux-x86, linux-arm, and macos runners.

maya: quick local debug: failing assertion in allocator_shard_test is in rebalance() path — kv cache warmup added a new code path that assumes shard_count > 1. If a commit changed default shard_count to 1, that explains it.

kevin: good catch. That matches the change in 5f2a1c7d where default_shards was set to env var override.

alice: PR #4381 CI shows queued, will post results. If CI goes green, we'll merge revert and then plan a proper fix + unit test to cover new path.

ci-bot: PR #4381 — linux-x86: ✅, linux-arm: ✅, macos: ✅ — all checks passed.

alice: merged revert PR #4381 — main should be green now. :tada:

ci-bot: main build: rerun triggered by merge; all builders reporting green.

raj: thanks everyone. Action items: @tom to follow up with a patch that preserves default_shards behavior and adds unit test; @maya to add a smoke test to CI that exercises rebalance path; @kevin to add a short bisect checklist in the eng-infra runbook.

tom: I'll take the fix, thanks for the quick revert.

alice: closing loop: incident resolved, no postmortem needed (low blast, quick revert). If anything flaky pops up, reopen this thread. :white_check_mark:
